rules.authority: America/Chicago civil days; build.py exports shared.js mailing limits to calendar_policy.json; helper independently validates.
rules.historicalVariants: New-publication windows do not rewrite historical/correction source dates. Date parity covers operational years 1900–2200, not all representable Date/Python years.

rules.authority: Seven-day spacing between distinct new ordinary due dates, independently enforced on publication.
rules.historicalVariants: Unchanged correction pairs, history, snow exceptions and read-only outstanding deadlines retain their rules.

rules.authority: Approved schedules/parameters compiled by existing pipeline; helper validates independently rather than trusting browser calculations.
rules.historicalVariants: Pre-2026-10-11 and current dated schedules retained. Corrections preserve source basis. Empty mandatory-appearance deposit may travel in drafts; issuance/legal wording hold remains in both runtimes.

rules.authority: Browser reporting projection and independent helper replay; compare canonical JSON, never loose Python equality.
rules.historicalVariants: Summary 6 required for current index; stale summaries rebuild from validated cases. JS undefined, boolean/number, UTF16 and civil-day semantics stay explicit.

rules.authority: Complementary browser restoration and helper storage-envelope/deposit validation; each distrusts peer input.
rules.historicalVariants: Draft envelope 1 differs from workspace backup 2 (reader retains 1 and 2). Browser full-shape/reference/history validation supplements helper checks. Import-only restore preserves unrelated work.

rules.authority: Owner request 2026-11-16: selected initial cited violations have no repair follow-up; other violations retain their deadlines and keep the case open.
rules.historicalVariants: Optional explicit disposition only; ordinary missing deadlines remain refused. Retained snapshots and original closure dates stay intact. No invented compliance or external closing write.
